scope: ISO 32000-2:2020 §§12.9–12.10, effective with Errata Collection 3; audit is feature-level, not a certification of all geodesy or projection standards.

locators.locator: viewport-selection prose; confirm the page footer against the source PDF if citing externally
GCS and projected-system entries; #321 annotates physical 619

errata.effect: replaces the contradictory 'either or both' wording with 'any' and updates the EPSG URL; the table behavior already followed the consistent table rows
Table 269 /LPTS Optional struck and Required inserted
defines /PCSM as a row-order affine 4x4 matrix acting on [x y z 1], and limits it to projected GCS
extends 3D coordinate triples condition to RichMedia annotations; those annotation pathways remain outside this bounded page-viewport audit
strikes 'real' in the PCSM description; numeric object type convention is supplied by general PDF object rules

features.source_rule: Viewport array is in drawing order and the last containing viewport wins; a multi-point measure uses the viewport containing its first point.
features.implementation: pdf_model::measurement::Viewports::at searches in reverse; distance/traced use the first point's viewport. Query::Measure connects a host path to that model.
features.assertions: Model test a_distance_is_measured_in_the_first_points_viewport_with_its_axes_scaled_first checks literal 18.36 u / 5 pl; viewer-core test a_path_is_measured_in_the_viewport_of_its_first_point checks names but both viewport dictionaries share one measure object, so it does not distinguish their scale numerically.
features.status: implemented; public numeric-selection assertion gap drafted

features.source_rule: Five-step carry/format procedure, descending-granularity units, precision/fraction/rounding and separators; the standard gives the exact output for 1.4505 miles.
features.implementation: measurement::format; scale factors are applied before distance/area calculation; implementation includes formatting controls in Table 268.
features.assertions: Model test the_clauses_own_example_formats_the_string_it_states exactly checks '1 mi 2,378 ft 7 5/8 in'. Public Query test the_clauses_own_formatting_reaches_a_host_through_the_query checks only unit substrings and suffix, not the expected numerical result.
features.status: implemented; public exact-number assertion gap drafted

features.source_rule: GCS and GPTS required; LPTS is required after #533 and pairs with GPTS. Bounds default is the full unit square. Bounds delimit where transformations are valid.
features.implementation: Geospatial model parses registration, maps unit square, checks bounds, and exposes public Query::Measure geographic location.
features.assertions: Public measuring tests assert geographic center and projected-display values; model tests exercise bounds and registration. Geographic test uses literal center coordinates. Relevant no-DCS and explicit DCS cases exist.
features.status: implemented for page viewport path; annotation triples, image/form XObject integration and all other object pathways not certified here

features.source_rule: Twelve matrix entries form the specified row-order affine 4x4 transformation on [x y z 1]; applies only for projected GCS, has priority over GPTS then.
features.implementation: PCSM matrix order and applicability represented in Geospatial; model tests use an asymmetric matrix and distinguish row-order/translation; public query tests cover projected mapping.
features.assertions: Distinct matrix values and projected/geographic control exist in measurement and geospatial model tests.
features.status: implemented for supported page viewport path; not asserting Geospatial3D annotation scope

features.source_rule: GCS is represented by one of EPSG or WKT per Tables 270/271; projected systems state projected eastings/northings. #321 resolves prose/table wording contradiction and updates the EPSG URL.
features.implementation: WKT1 and selected WKT2 paths parse; finite projection-method set is implemented against cited IOGP Guidance Note 7-2 examples. Code-only EPSG is declined by documented product scope; unsupported methods report refusal.
features.assertions: Tests include standard worked examples, inverse/forward numerical budgets, refusal paths, and public end-to-end position/display values.
features.status: implemented within explicit finite scope; not a claim of complete ISO 19162, EPSG registry, method, grid, epoch, or datum-transformation coverage

features.source_rule: PDU is optional Preferred Display Units (linear, area, angular); DCS is optional and 'shall be used for the display of position values'; formatting representation is controlled by the interactive processor.
features.implementation: PDU values parse/expose; host reports positions in six-place decimal degrees, with projected display coordinates where /DCS requests a supported projected system. Linear/area PDU presentation in a geospatial measurement UI is not exposed in the inspected public path.
features.assertions: Tests assert selected /DCS coordinates, but no public host consumer was found for PDU selection. Decimal degrees are an explicit processor choice; ADR 1593's assertion that angular PDU is not for positions is a local interpretation of a preference, not a demonstrated source mandate.
features.status: PDU consumer/use remains incomplete or inapplicable to the current position-only public query; do not claim all PDU preferences are implemented. Exact required behavior is not established by the 'preferred' entry and processor-controlled format sentence.

features.source_rule: PtData may be one dictionary or an array; Names are column names; XPTS rows match Names width, known LAT/LON/ALT have stated units/types, and rows have no guaranteed ordering/relationship.
features.implementation: point_data parses the structures and preserves cells as PDF Objects; viewport records only a has_point_data flag.
features.assertions: Current model assertion checks names and row/column dimensions, but not literal cell values or Object types; no public viewer/query consumer for point data was found.
features.status: Parsed/preserved data, not shown as a user-facing rendering feature. Reader obligation for an interactive viewport consumer is unclear; ledger's 'implemented' should be read narrowly as model interpretation, not display or semantic interpretation of arbitrary columns.
